Two Foreign Nationals Die in Bengaluru Hotel Pool Electrocution

Two foreign nationals died and two others were injured in an electrocution incident at a hotel swimming pool in Bengaluru. The suspected cause of the electrocution is believed to be the pool lighting system. The incident occurred at a hotel in Bengaluru.
